---
title: Migrating from options/execute (v1 to v2)
---

## The model/results split

Replace global options and `execute()` with a model constructor followed by a
fit call:

```{python}
#| eval: false
# v1: pt.options.pqdkm = (2, 2, 1, 2, 2); pt.execute(formula, data, ...)
model = pt.PanelARIMAGARCH(formula, data, entity="country", time="date")
results = model.fit(order=(2, 2, 1), garch_order=(2, 2))
```

The constructor accepts a `(entity, time)` `MultiIndex` or flat columns named
with `entity=` and `time=`. Public result statistics are available directly
from `Results`, including `params`, `bse`, `conf_int()`, and `summary()`.

## Name changes

| v1 | v2 |
|---|---|
| `T`, `ID`, `HF` | `time`, `entity`, `het_factors` |
| `Summary` | `Results` |
| `ll`, `dll`, `ddll` | `loglike`, `score`, `hessian` |
| `output`, `table` | `_output`, `_table` |
| `supress_output` | `suppress_output` |

The deprecated `pt.execute()` and `pt.options` compatibility layer remains
available during migration and emits `DeprecationWarning`.
